name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 14 Nov
state: The UK national terrorism threat level is Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after the Joint Terrorism Analysis Centre raised it from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026 (MI5; ProtectUK). Searches on 14 Nov found no announced change to the level.
for_you: Follow MI5 and police guidance: stay alert in crowded places and report suspicious activity to the police anti-terrorism hotline or 999 in an emergency.
why: The official MI5 assessment of the likelihood of a terrorist attack in the UK.
